Signs in with your saved credentials when the app opens and when a request comes back as expired. The device asks for your fingerprint, face or screen lock each time; without a screen lock it stays off. If it fails, a banner asks you to sign in.
Stored only on this device, in its secure storage, used to restore the app session. If you turn this on after signing in, sign in again to save them.

This section uses an unofficial connection to the official portal. It is in beta and may fail if the portal changes or cannot be reached. If something goes wrong, finish the task in the official portal.
Try without the second given name. Example: JUAN · PEREZ · GOMEZ finds JUAN CARLOS PEREZ GOMEZ.
Add the main guest (found by passport, name or temporary ID) to the queue before registering companions.
Anti-forgery token not found in page HTML.
CASERO is an independent, unofficial client for casero.rem.cu and SMS reporting. It is not affiliated with CIDP-MININT or any government agency. Verify each report through the corresponding service.
Fill in the fields above to send the SMS.
Use the phone number associated with your host account. Request phone association and wait for confirmation before reporting.
Each guest and companion needs a separate report. Check the reply's name and nationality, then send the confirmation code when prompted.
Built from the guests already cached on this device — reload the Guests tab first to include recent data.
Cached data has expired. Reload Guests before exporting.
Call 18808 from the phone associated with your host account and wait for confirmation. If you already have an account, manage the phone in Settings or on the official portal.

For a guest, enter the passport and stay days. For a companion, enter the main guest's passport and the companion's identity number; the main guest must already be registered. The app prepares the HC message for 7344. Review it in Messages and send it.
Wait for the service reply. Verify the guest's name and nationality, then select Confirm, enter the received confirmation code without HC, and send the prepared confirmation message to 7344.

The report is complete only after the service returns a final registration code. Each person needs a separate exchange. Confirmation requests expire after six hours; start a new report if one expires.
Check the name and nationality in the service reply before confirming. Requests expire after six hours; start a new report if that time has passed.
Check-out must be on or after check-in.
Check-out range end must be after its start.
Confirm the main guest's registration before reporting a companion.
Confirmation SMS sent. The report is complete only when the service returns a registration code.

Each guest and companion requires a separate report. The first reply supplies a confirmation code. Send HC followed by that code to 7344, then wait for the registration code that confirms the report.

SMS does not require internet, but needs cellular service. Carrier charges may apply.
